en.answer: If <<5114>> is chained to the effect of <<12257>>, so that <<12257>> is destroyed, you still draw 1 card.
en.question: If the effect of <<12257>> is activated, but my opponent chains <<5114>>, and <<12257>> is destroyed, is the effect to draw 1 card still applied?
